kids: Visit Santa and Mrs. Claus in a half hour slot
about: The Upper Arlington Public Library runs these Santa visits under the title Home for the Holidays.
They take place at the Miller Park Branch library in Old Arlington.
The branch address is 1901 Arlington Ave, Upper Arlington, OH 43212.
Six registered time slots run in half hour blocks from 4 to 7 PM.
Each visit lets a family meet Santa and Mrs. Claus.
Take home crafts and cookies are part of every slot.
The library lists the visits for babies, toddlers, preschoolers, school age children and families.
Registration is required, and each time slot is booked separately.
Families can call the Miller Park Branch at 614-488-5710 with questions.
The library posts its other holiday and storytime programs on its events calendar.
